title: Guide for Physical Planning of Computer Complexes, Part 3: Security Considerations
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This standard ( Part 3 ) provides guidance for identification of areas that pose a threat to security of computer complex and guidelines to follow at planning stage for improved security. 1.2 It does not cover areas related to data security through system design, operations and similar functions.
clause_3_terminology: Guide for Physical Planning of Computer Complexes

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
